The edition's own statement of rights (from eBible.org's page for this translation, https://ebible.org/pesOPV/copyright.htm):
> The Old Persian Version of the Holy Bible in the Persian language of Iran
> Public Domain
> Language: فارسی (Persian)
> Translation by: Wycliffe Bible Translators
> 2015-04-21

What was found:
Text: the Persian Old Version (Henry Martyn 1812, William Glen 1845, revised by Robert Bruce, published 1895); eBible's text uses modern Persian spelling and has a section heading.

Why it stays out: missing fact: whether eBible's text is the 1895 edition unchanged or a modern edit (modern spelling and headings), the place of the 1895 publication, and the translators' death years.

The read-aloud archive holds the Bible text chapter by chapter as plain text, a front file, the copyright page (copr.htm, left out of the source), and eBible.org's signing key (keys.asc, left out).

Sources of these facts: eBible.org's details page (https://ebible.org/details.php?id=pesOPV), the edition's copyright page (https://ebible.org/pesOPV/copyright.htm), https://www.bible.com/versions/136.
